title: Batman #15
desc:
THE ASSASSINATION OF BRUCE WAYNE!

Nothing is slowing down for the Caped Crusader in the aftermath of Bad Seeds as six assassins descend on Gotham with one target in their sights: billionaire playboy Bruce Wayne. It's all going down at El Granda Gala Enmascarado, and by the end of the night, Bruce Wayne will die before the eyes of the world. Time for Batman to get to work...

A pivotal chapter in the ongoing Batman epic that you won't want to miss!
